Sign in to start.

## What is signing in

Signing in opens your classes. You need a teacher account.

## How to sign in

Enter your {{ui:login.email}} and press {{ui:login.submit}}.

{{shot:login}}

## Good to know

- The classes page opens after you sign in.

## Problems and fixes

Forgot the password: ask an admin.

## Related questions

Then go to [[teacher.create-class]].
